title: test: Remove libgcrypt checks for 1.8 and below
description:
libgcrypt 1.8.0 or higher is required now, so remove the checks to
skip tests without it

commits_data.message:
test: Remove libgcrypt checks for 1.8 and below

libgcrypt 1.8.0 or higher is required now, so remove the checks to
skip tests without it
